text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—On whom will the Goddess of Victory smile today!
The grand stage to decide the pinnacle, the Nippon Derby!
Post time is finally upon us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-The ground feels like it's shaking...!
The Derby really is incredible every year...--

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Still, if it's Kris S-san, it won't matter to her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She said it herself.
Whether you can do what must be done—that is everything—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Those words and the sheer power of her running...
surely, no matter the circumstances, it shouldn't matter...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, no way!
Senior Gimlet's Derby is finally, truly about to begin...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What kind of incredible run will she show us today...!?
Is she gonna be crazy fast over 2400m too~!?
Urrgh! I wanna see it alreadyyy!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It's finally starting.
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all, just like always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...It's okay――to feel anxious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet is—strong. That is a fact—we determined as it is—based on her "results".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
On top of that... for the Trainer to find—
reasons for concern—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, that's completely right.
You don't need to force yourself to hide it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is not someone who wavers from anxiety.
She possesses absolute determination—the kind of Umamusume who takes a step forward and dispels fear before it can take root.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I wanted to walk
the same path beside her. And yet, if this continues—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Being different is――necessary... and important.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill our "mission" together—
we certainly don't need to be identical in every way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...At our core...
deep down—we are the same—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Making someone else's wish... your own—
That's—the most important... thing in common.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because—
we know we are the same in that regard—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I can... bounce ideas back and forth with Trainer. We can exchange opinions... and consult each other.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer's opinions—their thoughts—
...can be turned into my own strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Different people... joining their strength... for the same purpose...
I think... that is what it means... to walk together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—That I am standing here today.
...And running in the Japanese Derby.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Doing it—all on my own...
...surely would have been much harder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――However, you're here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Because my Trainer and I are the same—
and yet different—we were able to make it this far.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I will overcome those anxieties.
Believe in me... that it is my duty to do so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words she spoke so deliberately—every single one of them was filled with a reassuring kindness that gave me courage in how I carry myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To answer those feelings, not as her equal, but as her Trainer, I offer words to send her off—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's the Derby, Symboli Kris S is crazy calm, huh~
Doesn't she feel any jitters for the big stage?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but for this year's Derby,
it's gotta be that Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Welcome, to the end of a glorious chronicle of battle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...! Gimlet—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...What is this? —It feels unnatural.
This skin-pricking presence—
could it be emanating from Gimlet...?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(—No. No matter what it is, no matter who it is,
I will never waver.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Impressive.
To gaze back at me without wavering in the slightestâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Those stern, rigorous soul waves
are truly worthy of competing against me...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Victory, in my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well—
Wager your very mission, Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Staking my very reason for being—
Today, right here, I shall bring about destruction and the end!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this...!
Our "fated day" begins now!!
